message: Can you look at this ECG? I think it's normal, right?
reply:
**I would not call this ECG normal.** The rhythm looks regular at about 60 beats/minute, but there is clear **ST elevation in V2–V5**, with abnormal R-wave progression across the chest leads.

This raises concern for an **anterior heart attack**. Older heart damage can sometimes produce a similar appearance, so the image alone cannot establish whether this is new. It needs urgent clinical review, comparison with previous ECGs, and blood tests such as troponin. [Clinical guidance](https://academic.oup.com/eurheartj/article/44/38/3720/7243210)

**If you have chest discomfort, breathlessness, sweating, nausea, or faintness now, call emergency services immediately and don’t drive yourself.** If this ECG was taken recently, seek urgent assessment even without symptoms.

When was it recorded, and are you having any symptoms?
